integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the canonical vector field. Exact rational equilibrium and moment-offset algebra were replayed by the included dependency-free checker. Literature comparisons were made at statement/implication level, and access limitations are retained explicitly. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and bounded complete trajectories. It gives no existence, uniqueness, ergodicity, mixing-rate, physical-measure, or quantitative crossing-frequency result. The 1994 publisher full text was unavailable during review; exact equations were checked in a later full-text same-object paper that explicitly identifies the unmodified Sprott E case.
title: One-sided stationary geometry and forced sign crossing in the Sprott E flow
